candidates.title: I/O Analysis is All You Need: An I/O Analysis for Long-Sequence Attention
candidates.venue: International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems
candidates.abstract: As GPUs and other accelerators become increasingly popular, optimizing I/O operations between on-chip and off-chip memory is increasingly critical. I/O analysis, however, is complex, requiring a deep understanding of application dataflow and memory hierarchy. Developing a practical I/O analysis methodology remains a timely challenge. Self-attention is employed extensively in transformer models, but its quadratic memory complexity poses significant challenges to modern memory systems. In this study, we explore how to use I/O analysis to develop optimal solutions for accelerating exact long-sequence self-attention. We first introduce a novel I/O analysis for tall-and-skinny matrix-matrix multiplication, which captures the dominant data movement behavior of long-sequence self-attention. Guided by systematic I/O analysis, we develop AttenIO, an I/O-driven accelerator for exact long-sequence self-attention with three key optimizations: (1) an analytically derived I/O-optimal tiling and scheduling to minimize I/O operations, (2) fine-grained three-level communication-computation overlapping to hide I/O stalls, and (3) parallel execution patterns for efficient softmax. Our evaluation shows that AttenIO achieves a 1.6×-8.8× speedup over the state-of-the-art solutions. Although AttenIO is designed for self-attention, it also highlights the broader potential of I/O analysis as a principled foundation for guiding high-performance I/O optimizations.
candidates.reason: 長系列の厳密self-attentionについてI/O解析を用いてタイル化・スケジューリング・3階層の通信計算オーバーラップ・softmax並列化を導くAttenIO。ASPLOS 2026公式一次要旨で既存方式比1.6～8.8倍高速化を報告。Transformerの長文脈注意カーネル効率に直接関連。ただしLLM全体のdecode throughputを同倍率で改善するという意味ではない。

candidates.title: RQT: Hierarchical Residual Quantization for Multi-Model Compression
candidates.venue: Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics
candidates.reason: 共通基盤から個別微調整された複数LLMの重みを、ボトムアップのモデル類似性統合とトップダウンの残差量子化を行うResidual Quantization Treeで共有する。ACL Findings 2025公式一次要旨では数学・コード・チャット・中国語LLMの複数モデルに対し、実効約2bitで平均精度低下約3%と報告。複数モデルの保存・配備効率に直接関係するが、実サービスでのトークン毎遅延改善は別途確認が必要。

candidates.title: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference via Activation-guided FFN Distillation on Raspberry Pi
candidates.reason: Raspberry Pi 4上のLLaMA-3.2-1Bでautoregressive decodeの主要ボトルネックがFFNにあるとプロファイリングし、活性値に基づくFFN中間次元の蒸留縮小（AFD）を提案。CVPR 2026 Workshop公式一次要旨によればPyTorch/LiteRT、INT8/INT4で推論スループット改善とQA品質の小幅劣化を報告。ただし要旨には具体的な倍率がないため数値は未確認とする。

candidates.title: SWSC: Shared Weight for Similar Channel in LLM
candidates.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have spurred development in multiple industries. However, the growing number of their parameters brings substantial storage and computing burdens, making it essential to explore model compression techniques for parameter reduction and easier deployment. We propose SWSC, an LLM compression method based on the concept of Shared Weight for Similar Channel. It uses the K-Means clustering algorithm to cluster model weights channel-by-channel, generating clusters with highly similar vectors within each. A representative vector from each cluster is selected to approximately replace all vectors in the cluster, significantly reducing the number of model weight parameters. However, approximate restoration will inevitably cause damage to the performance of the model. To tackle this issue, we perform singular value decomposition on the weight error values before and after compression and retain the larger singular values and their corresponding singular vectors to compensate for the accuracy. The experimental results show that our method can effectively ensure the performance of the compressed LLM even under low-precision conditions.
candidates.reason: LLM重みをチャネルごとにK-meansでクラスタ化して代表ベクトルを共有し、復元誤差を低ランクSVDで補償する圧縮。著者公開arXiv前刷りではLlama-2-7Bの注意Q/K射影のみをWikiText-2で評価し、平均2 bitのQ射影でperplexity 7.297、K射影で7.148、Q&Kで10.886と報告。モデル全層の速度改善や生成品質の実運用保証ではなく、主として保存量削減の研究。会議版の著者追加・題名変更があり、同一性はimport inboxで最終照合。
